name: github-graphql
title: GitHub GraphQL
summary: The GitHub GraphQL API on api.github.com/graphql: viewer, users, repositories with issues, pull requests and stargazers, search, rateLimit, and the createIssue and addComment mutations.

upstream.notes: GitHub's public schema as published by octokit (about 1.2 MB). Pinned to the 2024-07-08 commit: the newest one (597478f, 2025-02-27) declares EnterpriseOwnerInfo.repositoryDeployKeySetting twice, which `mockingbird serve` cannot load. The subset keeps its type, field and argument names, so the scenarios' Query.rateLimit applies to both.

body.query: { viewer { login name } rateLimit { limit remaining } }
